items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Willie Maiden and I finished Westlake College of Music together in Hollywood you see. And he called me up... make this gig with us

ctx.x: Yeah, well you probably better not. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

But all I’m saying, the important thing is that, I mean this was a highly intellectual man. This was no, you know, peddler or anything like that. I mean he was highly respected as a human being. But that was the only time they were traveling on the road together. Willie Maiden was the straw boss. That’s how I got in the band, because Willie Maiden and I finished Westlake College of Music together in Hollywood you see. And he called me up, they were on their way — in fact they were coming to Buffalo to play a gig,…
Yeah. Then they don’t want to pay you.
